3.description: Runner on first steals second; no attempt to throw him out-credit batter with a called strike.

4.description: Hit by pitch, batter takes first.

5.description: Called third strike.

6.description: Game called because of rain. If game is being played in domed stadium, a one-hour power failure occurs. Pitchers regain full starting strength when the game resumes.

11.description: Fly ball to 20-22. (If 11 is within batter’s HR Rating, fly to 20-25).

12.description: Fly ball to 10-25. (If 12 is within batter’s HR Rating, fly to 10-28).

13.description: Fly ball to 5-24. (If 13 is within batter’s HR Rating, fly to 5-27).

14.description: Grounder to 3-26. (If 14 is within batter’s HR Rating, fly to 3-28).

15.description: Grounder to 4-26. (If 15 is within batter's HR Rating, fly to 4-28).

16.description: Grounder to 4-20. (If 16 is within batter’s HR Rating, fly to 4-27).

22.description: Grounder to 8-21. (If 22 is within batter’s HR Rating, fly to 8-28).

23.description: Grounder to 17-23. (If 23 is within batter's HR Rating, fly to 24-25).

33.description: Grounder to 16-20 or 20-16, Offensive Manager’s option.

34.description: Grounder to 15-20 or 13-20, Offensive Manager’s option.

35.description: Line drive base hit over first base to 3-20 in right field; if two out, foul-pitch again.

44.description: Grounder off second baseman’s glove to 6-13; runners advance one base, batter safe at first.

45.description: High hopper to 10-10; runners advance one base; only play is at first.

46.description: Line drive base hit over third base to wall, square 3-? in left field.

55.description: Grounder to 3-18; if none or one out, foul ball — pitch again.

66.description: Error; roll one die and see chart below.

1.description: Center fielder drops line drive for two-base error; runners score; batter safe at second. If CF is Superior and no error, ball is caught. Complete play by rolling dice and beginning throw from two squares in front of CF.

2.description: Same as above except if CF is Superior, there is no error. Ball is caught on square 18-18. Complete play by rolling dice.

3.description: Same as above except if CF is Superior, there is no error. Ball is caught on square 18-21. Complete play by rolling dice.

4.description: Right fielder drops fly ball for two-base error; runners score; batter safe at second or (if asterisked as) safe at third. If RF is Superior and no error, fly ball caught on square 7-20 in right field. Complete play by rolling dice.

5.description: Same as above except if RF is Superior, there is no error. Instead, ball is a base hit grounder to 7-18 in right field. Complete play by rolling dice normally.

6.description: Ball drops in for a single; right (or left) fielder (depending on how batter pulls) throws wild allowing runners to score and batter to reach second. Roll one die again to see if batter is caught over-running second base: 1-3 = Out; 4-6 = Safe at second. If RF (or LF) is Superior and no error, runners score but batter is thrown out at second base. Score 9 or 7-4-6.

11.description: Line drive hit to two squares diagonally to right of center fielder.

12.description: Grounder hit to shortstop. If he’s playing in, batter safe at first; runner is out at home; other advances safely to third. If he’s playing deep, all runners are running but only play is at first.

13.description: Grounder hit to second baseman. If he’s playing in, batter safe at first; runner is out at home; other advances safely to third. If he’s playing deep, all runners are running but only play is at first.

16.description: Grounder to shortstop. Runner on second is hit by the ball and is out. Batter is safe on a single; other holds third.

22.description: Line drive to shortstop; roll one die for possible double play. If roll is equal to or more than number of squares from second or third base, that runner is out.

25.description: Grounder to 8-8; all runners advance safely; only play is at first base.

26.description: Pop up to 1-13; if caught, runner out trying for home; other runner advances to third base.

33.description: Fly ball to 17-18 or 16-19, Offensive Manager’s option.

44.description: Pop up to 1-9; if two outs, pop up to 2-10 and roll one die to see if fielder drops it (l=error).

45.description: Line drive to third baseman; one out only - no chance for double play.

55.description: Grounder to 8-9; all runners advance safely; only play is at first base.

56.description: Sinking liner to four squares in front of centerfielder who makes a shoestring catch. Roll two dice for possible triple play. Begin action by throwing from where ball is caught. If roll is equal to or more than number of squares from second and/or third base, that runner(s) is also out.

66.description: Error; roll one die and see chart below.

1.description: Shortstop throws wild to first; everyone scores; batter reaches second base. If SS is Superior and no error, all runners advance but batter out.

2.description: Same as above except if SS is Superior and no error, runner on third scores; runner on second holds; only play is at first.

3.description: Ball goes through third baseman's legs (five squares behind him); runners advance one base; batter safe; everyone has option to try for an extra base. Start action by fielding ball with nearest outfielder. If 3B is Superior and no error, ball is deflected to shortstop. Everyone advances one base. Batter safe on infield single.

4.description: First baseman bobbles high hopper; runners advance; batter safe. If IB is Superior, no error; runners advance safely; batter is out. If IB is playing in at the time, and no error, runner on third is out at home; batter and other runner safely advance.

5.description: Third baseman throws wild to first; runners advance one base; batter safe at first. If 3B is Superior and no error, runners advance but batter is out.

6.description: Same as above but if 3B is Superior and no error, runner thrown out at home. Batter safe at first; other safe at third.

1.description: Base on balls.

2.description: Passed ball; roil one die - if 6, batter walks; runners advance one base only.

3.description: Called third strike.

4.description: Balk.

5.description: Hit by pitch, batter takes first.

6.description: Strike out; catcher drops called third strike; tags batter out. Both runners may attempt to steal and add four to their dice roll.

11.description: Fly ball to 17-25. (If 11 is within batter’s HR Rating, fly to 17-27).

12.description: Grounder to 3-26. (If 12 is within batter’s HR Rating, fly to 3-28).

13.description: Grounder to 3-25. (If 13 is within batter’s HR Rating, fly to 5-27).

14.description: Grounder to 6-26. (If 14 is within batter’s HR Rating, fly to 6-28).

15.description: Grounder to 8-25. (If 15 is within batter’s HR Rating, fly to 8-27).

16.description: Grounder to 4-21. (If 16 is within batter's HR Rating, fly to 4-28).

22.description: Grounder to 4-20. (If 22 is within batter’s HR Rating, fly to 8-28).

23.description: Grounder to 14-19. (If 23 is within batter’s HR Rating, fly to 14-26).

26.description: Grounder to 3-18; ball goes to opposite field.

34.description: Grounder to 16-19 or 14-19, Offensive Manager’s option.

35.description: Grounder to 17-17; advance one base only regardless of Hit & Run.

46.description: Grounder to 3-17 or 17-3, Offensive Manager’s option.

55.description: Grounder to 3-16 or 16-3, Offensive Manager’s option.

66.description: Error; roll one die and see chart below.

1.description: Left fielder drops shallow fly ball; all runners advance one. If LF is Superior and no error, ball is caught on square 7-16 in left field. Complete play by rolling dice.

2.description: Same as above but third baseman is knocked out when he collides with left fielder and is out for the rest of the game - even if the ball is caught.

3.description: Fly ball dropped by left fielder on square 6-22. Runners, who had been holding, now may attempt to advance. Start action by beginning throw from square 6-22; then move runners; continue throw; etc. If LF is Superior, there is no error. Ball is caught on square 6-22. Complete play by rolling dice.

4.description: Center fielder drops fly ball for error; runners advance two; batter safe at first. If CF is Superior, there is no error. Ball is caught but runner on third scores. All others hold.

5.description: Right fielder drops ball when he collides with center fielder; all runners score; batter reaches third. Roll one die to see extent of injuries: 1-3 = both fielders shaken up but can continue to play; 4 = RF out for the game; 5 = CF out for the game; 6 = RF and CF out for the game. If RF is Superior, no error, He catches the ball despite collision. All runners advance two bases. Roll one die to determine extent of injuries. (See chart above).

6.description: Right fielder catches ball for out but throws wild to home plate allowing all runners to advance one base. If RF is Superior, there is no error. A good throw keeps runners from advancing.

11.description: High bouncer to 8-10 if nearest fielder is playing deep; grounder to 8-16 if nearest field is playing in, base hit.

12.description: High fly to one square behind center fielder.

14.description: Line drive to shortstop; roll one die for possible double play. If roll is equal to or more than number of squares from second or third base, that runner is out.

15.description: Sharp grounder to third baseman; if not on bag, no play at third.

22.description: One bounce grounder back to the box; roll for possible error (1- error by pitcher)

23.description: Grounder to 9-10; runners on second and third advance safely. If nearest fielder nearest fielder is nearest fielder is

24.description: Slow dribbler to 3-6; only play is at home and / or batter if nearest fielder is playing in is playing deep, only play is on runner going to second and/or batter.

25.description: Grounder to 6-8; only play is at home and / or batter if nearest fielder is playing in. If playing deep, only play is on runner going to second and/or batter.

26.description: Grounder to 5-8; only play is at home and / or batter if nearest fielder is playing in. If playing deep, only play is on runner going'to second and/or batter.

33.description: Grounder to 7-9; runners on second and third advance safely.

45.description: Line drive to 4-9; one out only - no chance for double play.

46.description: Pop up to 6-9 or 9-6, Offensive Manager’s option.

55.description: Deep drive (fly ball) to three squares diagonally behind centerfielder. If in stands, ignore and move ball back only as far as it can go on playing field, regardless of wind factor.

66.description: Error; roll one die and see chart below.

1.description: Pitcher bobbles ball and then falls; everyone safe. If P is Superior and no error, complete play by rolling dice.

2.description: Catcher drops throw from shortstop; everyone safe. If C is Superior and no error, runner out at home.

3.description: Catcher drops throw from second baseman; everyone safe. If C is Superior and no error, runner out at home.

4.description: Third baseman boots ball; everyone safe. If 3B is Superior and no error, complete play by rolling dice; but no play at third unless fielder is on the base.

5.description: Ball gets by first baseman; everyone safe. If IB is Superior and no error, complete play by rolling dice.

6.description: Catcher drops pop up near the plate in foul territory; runners hold; batter still batting. If C is Superior and no error, he catches ball for an out.

1.description: Base on balls.

2.description: Wild pitch; everyone advances; roll one dice - if 6, batter walks.

3.description: Runner picked off first (A-C, P0-1B).

4.description: Called strike out.

5.description: Hit by pitch, batter takes first.

6.description: Called third strike; batter ejected for disputing call.
